groups.interpretation: Builder signature annotations do not validate inputs or direction; native tail owns admission. No local public/validity filter.

Last strike by negative index; empty sequence fails before map read. Look up decisive stored source_index then convert mapped main High and Low in that order directly to Decimal. No source timestamp/index consistency assertion.

Exact bullish branch computes Low+(High-Low)/Decimal(3), otherwise High-(High-Low)/Decimal(3); preserve subtraction/division/addition order and context, full main range, no quantization or policy validation.

Construct scale record using supplied direction, ordinal, prior count, count of confirmed strikes, supplied Fibonacci, decisive strike stored index/time/extreme; broken_level null. Semantic source price not drawing price or full-main extreme.

Drawing price plus start/end independently computed from decisive strike time minus/plus chronology.timeframe, not mapped candle time. Pass internal flag unchanged, default calculation_valid true; return only after successful field evaluation.
Reset builder accepts previous line nullable, no direct kind/owner/direction validation; BL03 validates direction only when reached.
Read reset.index then int, lookup that key, convert main High then Low, compute divisor-five exact mirrored drawing before reading mapped main timestamp. No reset event timestamp consumed.

Validity is negated conjunction; previous nonnull first, then BL03 from int(previous source_index)+1 to reset_index inclusive. Positional first strict crossing and stored index check, not exact lower stop. If prior absent no stop scan or direction validation here.

Only if prior exists and BL03 true evaluate strict extension of full reset main extreme versus directly converted prior semantic extreme (B low<, R high>). Finite equality cannot invalidate; no previous calculation_valid/internal check.

Always construct Reset record if no failure, even invalid. Counts/Fibonacci null, source_index is converted reset.index map key (not read from mapped candle), source_time mapped main timestamp, source_extreme main Low/High.

Read and direct Decimal-convert broken_level after validity derivation, retain distinct drawing price, main time ± timeframe, calculated validity and supplied internal. Malformed required fields can fail even for invalid record; no public filtering.
Frozen slotted checkpoint defaults previous reaction/count null, spacing and line_count zero. Shallow reference storage; annotations no validators, not independent snapshot of nested state.
Tail accepts caller output and optional checkpoint list; no start, direction, prefix length, or map-alignment guard inside this helper; native wrappers gate admission.
Read chronology main list, map stored int index to original object in traversal order; later duplicate key overwrites, map is new but values shared.
Fresh reset grouping keyed by int(from_first_idx) preserving input iteration order, append original reset refs. No sort, dedup, direction or lifecycle filter.
Restore previous reaction/count and counter from checkpoint, derive has_blue from caller output truthiness rather than checkpoint.line_count. Invalid/internal count as output. No consistency check.
Truthy start slices reactions, falsy uses original sequence; enumerate start+1 even if direct helper called with unusual start. Input order controls ordinals.
Read internal bool default false before converting required mode to string and comparing exact A. Flag is record metadata, not an admission or spacing gate.
Mode A prefers nonnull anchor, else nonnull leg_boundary; zero retained; missing both raises. Direct Decimal reference conversion before clearing previous_count, no spacing reset.
All other modes require previous reaction else raise; choose prior box_bottom B/box_top otherwise, direct Decimal. Not a separate mode-B validator.
Call BL06 with current reaction, direction, chronology, reference and shared map; confirmation cache can change before any output append. Failure propagates.
Scale candidate only previous_count nonnull then len(strikes)>previous_count; strict count increase. Initialize scale_emitted false. Candidate required before (no Blue or counter>=1).
Build Scale then append to caller output before setting has_blue, spacing zero, emitted true. Builder or append failure prevents subsequent local state updates; no transaction.
If has_blue and not scale_emitted increment counter once, including internal reactions; name healthy is not a predicate. Increment precedes reset scan.
Read current int First to lookup reset group with empty-list default. Each reset skipped when has_blue and counter<1. No event-time sorting or kind check here.

Pass latest output line (regardless of validity/internal) or null to BL08. Append returned Reset even invalid, then set has_blue true and counter zero; thus same-group subsequent Reset suppressed. Scale also suppresses same-Reaction Reset.

After all matching resets, set previous reaction to original ref then count len(strikes); if checkpoint list not None, evaluate shallow copy then count/counter/len(output), build checkpoint then append. Copy/checkpoint failure can leave completed output changes; no local rollback.
Return exact caller-owned output object, no sorting, copying, or public visibility projection. Checkpoint.line_count records prefix length only.
Public batch detector defaults resets empty tuple, checks direction membership exact supported strings before allocating calculation state. Other malformed values can raise natively.

Delegate to BL09 with start 0, fresh default checkpoint and fresh output, no checkpoint capture. Return full calculation ledger including invalid/internal; no lifecycle acceptance or public projection.
